verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; cost per lead is being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 102 leads at an average cost of $7.35 per lead, but the final 7 days told a different story: leads fell 34% week-over-week while spend held nearly flat, pushing cost per lead up 49% in that window. The likely cause is audience fatigue on the Meta retargeting campaign that carries the full ad budget — with no other channel running to absorb the drop. Ad creative is being refreshed to break the fatigue cycle, and the pipeline is being reviewed separately because 105 leads entered your system this period but none converted to booked appointments, which points to an intake gap rather than an ads problem. Next week should show whether the creative changes stabilise lead volume and cost.
